examples.ko: 경찰이 범죄 자금을 돈세탁한 혐의를 조사하고 있어요.
examples.en: The police are investigating suspicions of laundering criminal funds.

examples.ko: 돈세탁을 막기 위해 은행이 거래를 확인해요.
examples.en: Banks check transactions to prevent money laundering.
The news explained money laundering methods in detail.
I heard all the accounts used for money laundering were frozen.

examples.ko: 그 영화는 돈세탁을 하는 사람들의 이야기예요.
examples.en: That movie is about people who launder money.
The employees received anti-money-laundering training.

explain: '돈'과 '세탁'이 합쳐진 말로, 불법으로 번 돈을 깨끗한 돈처럼 보이게 하는 일을 말해요. 뉴스에서는 '자금 세탁'이라고도 하고, 둘 다 같은 뜻으로 써요. '돈세탁하다', '돈세탁을 하다' 모두 가능해요.

phrases.example: 뉴스에서 자금 세탁 사건을 자세히 설명했어요.
phrases.en: The news explained the money laundering case in detail.
phrases.nuance_ko: '돈세탁'과 같은 뜻이고 뉴스나 글에서 더 격식 있게 들려요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same meaning as '돈세탁', but sounds more formal in news and writing.

phrases.example: 그 회사가 돈세탁을 했다는 소문이 있어요.
phrases.en: There is a rumor that the company laundered money.
phrases.nuance_ko: '돈세탁하다'와 같은 뜻이고, 목적어처럼 '을/를'을 넣어서 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: Same as '돈세탁하다', with the object marker added.

phrases.example: 그는 돈세탁 혐의로 조사를 받고 있어요.
phrases.en: He is being investigated on suspicion of money laundering.
phrases.nuance_ko: 사건이나 재판 뉴스에서 자주 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A common pairing in crime and court news.

explain_en: It combines '돈' (money) and '세탁' (washing), meaning making illegally earned money look clean. News also says '자금 세탁', with the same meaning. Both '돈세탁하다' and '돈세탁을 하다' work.

en: rationing; distribution (of food, supplies, or films)

examples.en: I heard that during the war people received rice through rationing.

examples.ko: 이 영화는 한국 배급사가 따로 있어요.
examples.en: This film has a separate Korean distributor.

examples.ko: 마을 사람들이 줄을 서서 식량 배급을 기다려요.
examples.en: The villagers stand in line waiting for food rations.
Water is handed out only twice a day.
The rations were delayed, so the children went hungry.
In the army, they hand out clothes and shoes.

explain: '배급'은 부족한 물건을 정해진 양만큼 나눠 줄 때 써요. 영화나 책을 극장과 서점에 내보내는 일도 '배급'이라서 '배급사'라는 말이 있어요. 광고지를 공짜로 돌리는 건 '배포'예요.

phrases.en: The government distributed rice to families in need.
phrases.nuance_ko: 명사 '배급'에 '-하다'를 붙인 동사로, 물건을 나눠 주는 사람이 주어예요.
phrases.nuance_en: The verb form, where the subject is the one handing out supplies.

phrases.en: People stood in line and received their rations.
phrases.nuance_ko: 나눠 주는 쪽이 아니라 받는 쪽에서 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used from the side of the person who receives the ration.

phrases.en: Which company is this movie's distributor?
phrases.nuance_ko: 영화를 극장에 내보내는 회사를 말해요.
phrases.nuance_en: The company that sends a film out to theaters.

explain_en: 배급 is for handing out scarce goods in fixed amounts. Sending films or books out to theaters and stores is also 배급, which is why 배급사 (distributor) exists. Handing out flyers for free is 배포.

examples.en: This car is produced in Korea.
Rice is produced most in autumn.

examples.ko: 새 휴대폰이 다음 달부터 생산될 거예요.
examples.en: The new phone will be produced starting next month.
The products made go straight to the airport.

examples.ko: 이 지역에서는 사과가 많이 생산되고 있어요.
examples.en: Many apples are grown in this region.
The factory stopped, so goods couldn't be produced.

explain: 공장에서 만들든 농장에서 키우든 '생산되다'를 써요. 짝말은 '소비하다(consume)'예요. 집에서 만드는 음식에는 쓰지 않고 '만들어지다'를 써요.

phrases.example: 이 빵은 매일 아침 가게에서 만들어져요.
phrases.en: This bread is made at the shop every morning.
phrases.nuance_ko: '생산되다'보다 쉽고 일상적인 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An easier, everyday alternative to 생산되다.

phrases.en: This toy is mass-produced in a factory.
phrases.nuance_ko: 많은 양을 한꺼번에 만든다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means produced in large quantities.

phrases.en: That model is no longer produced.
phrases.nuance_ko: 더 이상 만들지 않는 물건에 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used for products that are no longer made.

explain_en: Whether made in a factory or grown on a farm, use '생산되다'. Its counterpart is '소비하다' (consume). For food made at home, use '만들어지다' instead.

dis.h: made in quantity; goods and crops

p.n: 제조되다 stresses factory manufacturing; 생산되다 is broader and also covers crops.

examples.ko: 다음 달부터 시판되는 신제품을 미리 써 봤어요.
examples.en: I tried out the new product that goes on sale next month ahead of time.

examples.ko: 이 약은 허가 없이는 시판될 수 없어요.
examples.en: This medicine can't be put on the market without approval.

examples.ko: 시판되기 전에 안전 검사를 꼭 받아야 해요.
examples.en: It must pass a safety inspection before it goes on sale.
The newly released snack is very popular.

examples.ko: 해외에서 시판되고 있는 제품이 한국에도 들어왔어요.
examples.en: A product sold overseas has now come to Korea too.

examples.ko: 이 제품이 시판되면 가장 먼저 사고 싶어요.
examples.en: When this product goes on sale, I want to buy it first.

explain: '판매되다'는 팔리는 모든 경우에 쓰지만, 시판되다는 가게에서 일반 사람에게 팔기 시작한다는 느낌이 있어요. 주로 새 제품이나 약 소식에서 나와요.

phrases.en: This snack is on sale in stores now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 가게에서 팔고 있다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means it is currently being sold in stores.

phrases.en: The new product went on sale this week.
phrases.nuance_ko: 새 제품이 처음 나올 때 쓰기 좋은 모양이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A good form for when a new product first comes out.

phrases.en: The company will put the new product on the market next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 팔리는 쪽이 아니라 파는 회사가 주어일 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when the seller, not the product, is the subject.

explain_en: 판매되다 covers anything that is sold, but 시판되다 carries the sense of starting to be sold to the general public in shops. It appears mostly in news about new products or medicine.

dis.h: go on sale commercially; new product launch

p.n: 시판되다 stresses the product is released to the market; 판매되다 just says it is sold.

en: to be used regularly; to be patronized

examples.en: This app is widely used by students.
That restaurant is a favorite of office workers.
It is a medicinal herb that has been used regularly since long ago.

examples.ko: 애용되는 교통카드는 버스와 지하철에서 다 써요.
examples.en: The popular transit card can be used on both buses and subways.

examples.ko: 이 길은 자전거 타는 사람들에게 애용될 거예요.
examples.en: This road will be favored by people who ride bikes.

examples.ko: 한때 애용됐던 물건이 지금은 박물관에 있어요.
examples.en: An item that was once used regularly is now in a museum.

explain: '많이 쓰이다'보다 사람들이 좋아해서 자주 쓴다는 느낌이 있어요. 주어는 사람이 아니라 물건, 가게, 서비스예요. 쓰는 사람을 주어로 하면 '애용하다'를 써요.

phrases.en: This transit card is widely used all over the country.
phrases.nuance_ko: 많은 사람이 좋아해서 쓴다는 뜻으로 '널리'와 함께 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used with '널리' to mean many people like and use it.

phrases.example: 그 가게는 동네 사람들에게 애용되고 있어요.
phrases.en: That shop is regularly used by the neighborhood people.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금도 계속 자주 쓰인다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means it is still being used often right now.

phrases.en: This word is used a lot these days.
phrases.nuance_ko: '애용되다'보다 일상적이고, 좋아하는 느낌은 없어요.
phrases.nuance_en: More everyday than 애용되다, without the feeling of liking it.

explain_en: It has more of a liked and regularly used feeling than 많이 쓰이다. The subject is a thing, shop, or service rather than a person. If the user is the subject, 애용하다 is used instead.

en: to be distributed; to circulate (goods in the market)

examples.en: This fruit is distributed across the country.
Fake goods are circulating in the market.
These vegetables go straight from the farm, so they're fresh.

examples.ko: 유통된 지 오래된 제품은 사지 마세요.
examples.en: Don't buy products that have been on the market for a long time.
False information circulated on the internet.

examples.ko: 새 음료는 다음 달부터 편의점에서 유통될 거예요.
examples.en: The new drink will be on sale at convenience stores from next month.

explain: 물건이 만든 곳에서 가게를 거쳐 소비자에게 가는 흐름이에요. 말로는 '팔리다', '나오다'를 쓰기도 해요. 식품 포장에 '유통 기한'이 적혀 있는데, 가게에서 팔 수 있는 마지막 날이에요.

phrases.example: 이 제품은 전 세계에 널리 유통돼요.
phrases.en: This product is widely distributed around the world.
phrases.nuance_ko: '널리'를 붙여 많은 곳에서 팔린다는 뜻을 더해요.
phrases.nuance_en: 널리 adds the sense that it is sold in many places.

phrases.example: 그 책은 지금 시장에 유통되지 않아요.
phrases.en: That book is not on the market now.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건이 가게에서 팔리지 않는다고 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to say an item is not sold in stores.
phrases.en_equiv: to not be on the market

phrases.example: 그 과자는 전국 마트에서 유통되고 있어요.
phrases.en: That snack is being sold in supermarkets nationwide.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 시장에 나와 팔리고 있다는 진행의 느낌을 줘요.
phrases.nuance_en: Gives a sense that goods are on the market and circulating right now.

explain_en: Goods flow from the producer through shops to consumers. In speech, '팔리다' or '나오다' are used too. Food packages show '유통 기한', the last date a shop may sell it.

dis.h: goods get distributed; passive, no actor

p.n: 유통하다 needs an actor and an object, so the same sentence does not work.

en: to be rented; to be leased

examples.en: This building is rented out as offices.
The empty shop was rented out last month.

examples.ko: 임대된 집은 마음대로 고치면 안 돼요.
examples.en: You must not alter a rented house as you like.

examples.ko: 이 땅은 오 년 동안 임대될 예정이에요.
examples.en: This land is scheduled to be leased for five years.

examples.ko: 임대되기 전에 집을 한번 보러 갈까요?
examples.en: Shall we go see the house before it's rented out?
The car is already rented out, so it's not here now.

explain: 임대는 집주인이 빌려주는 쪽의 말이고, 빌리는 쪽은 '임차'라고 해요. 그래서 집이 임대되었다는 말은 누군가 빌려 쓰고 있다는 뜻이에요. 일상에서는 '세를 놓다', '월세로 나오다'도 많이 써요.

phrases.example: 이 건물은 지금 사무실로 임대되어 있어요.
phrases.en: This building is currently rented out as offices.
phrases.nuance_ko: 지금 누군가 빌려 쓰고 있는 상태를 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used to describe the current state of being rented by someone.

phrases.example: 이 집은 다음 달에 임대될 예정이에요.
phrases.en: This house is scheduled to be rented out next month.
phrases.nuance_ko: 앞으로 빌려줄 계획을 알릴 때 쓰는 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: An expression used to announce a coming rental.

phrases.en: The shop hasn't been rented yet.
phrases.nuance_ko: 빌려 가는 사람이 아직 없다는 뜻의 부정 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A negative expression meaning no one has rented it yet.

explain_en: '임대' is the lender's side, and the borrower's side is '임차'. So a house described as 임대되다 is now being rented by someone. In everyday speech '세를 놓다' and '월세로 나오다' are also common.

en: to be treated; to be sold; to be served

examples.en: Imported fruit is also handled at this market.
That was treated as a simple mistake.
Dangerous items must be handled with care.

examples.ko: 지각 세 번은 결석 한 번으로 취급된다고 해요.
examples.en: They say three late arrivals are counted as one absence.

examples.ko: 한 번 쓴 제품은 중고로 취급되니까 값이 내려가요.
examples.en: A used product is treated as secondhand, so its price drops.

examples.ko: 중고 책은 새 책과 같은 값으로 취급되지 않아요.
examples.en: Used books are not treated at the same price as new books.

explain: 사람보다는 일, 물건, 상품이 어떻게 다뤄지는지에 써요. '중고로 취급되다', '이 가게에서 취급되다'처럼 말해요. 사람이 억울하게 대접받는 건 '취급당하다'예요. 가게 안내문의 '취급 품목'이라는 말도 자주 보여요.

phrases.en: The items our store sells are fruits.
phrases.nuance_ko: 가게에서 파는 물건의 종류를 말하는 명사 표현이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A noun phrase for the kinds of goods a shop deals in.

phrases.en: Opened items are treated as used.
phrases.nuance_ko: 물건이 어떤 상태로 다뤄지는지 말할 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Says how an item is classified or handled.

phrases.en: Alcohol isn't sold at this store.
phrases.nuance_ko: 그 가게나 곳에서 다루지 않는다는 뜻이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Means the shop or place does not deal in it.

explain_en: It is used for how things, jobs or products are handled rather than for people, as in '중고로 취급되다' or '이 가게에서 취급되다'. When a person is treated unfairly, use '취급당하다'. You also often see '취급 품목' (items handled) on store notices.

dis.h: be handled or regarded in some way

p.n: 취급당하다 implies suffering, so it does not fit a positive meaning.

en: to be returned; to be restored

examples.en: The profits were returned to the employees.
The donations are being given back to the local community.

examples.ko: 모든 문제가 돈으로 환원되는 건 아니에요.
examples.en: Not every problem can be reduced to money.
It takes time to be restored to the original state.
The system was changed so that taxes are returned to citizens.
They promised that the earnings would go back to society.

explain: 환원되다는 가져간 것이 다시 돌아가거나, 복잡한 것이 하나로 줄어들 때 써요. 이익, 세금, 기부처럼 돈이 사회로 돌아갈 때 많이 나와요. 일상에서는 '돌아가다'가 쉬워요.

phrases.en: Taxes should be returned to the residents.
phrases.nuance_ko: 받은 돈이나 혜택이 다시 사람들에게 돌아갈 때 쓰는 짝말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: A pairing for money or benefits going back to the people.

phrases.en: The changed settings were restored to the original.
phrases.nuance_ko: 바뀐 것이 처음 상태로 다시 돌아갈 때 써요.
phrases.nuance_en: Used when something changed goes back to its first state.

phrases.en: The proceeds go to neighbors in need.
phrases.nuance_ko: '환원되다'보다 쉽고 일상에서 자연스럽게 쓰는 말이에요.
phrases.nuance_en: Easier than 환원되다 and natural in everyday speech.

explain_en: This is used when something taken goes back, or when something complex is boiled down to one thing. It is common for profits, taxes, and donations flowing back to society. In everyday speech, '돌아가다' (go back) is easier.
